t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Jayim lagataxanaxanec ñi Dios hua nagui que jayim vi'ichi' ñachalataxaq que ya'yi'iñite' que qami sashila'. Paraque jayim racataxanaxanqui' nagui quenataxa' que ra iqalaxa chaqai requesaxanxai da yoxoric chaqai raresallaxai. Qaica ca lya Dios que que qami napacaleq. Qami yotavañi que na elchiqo'. Qami qaica viñire'a.
